event_headline: Ombudsman orders Romualdez and Zaldy Co to file counter-affidavits on flood control corruption charges

chronology.action: Ordered Martin Romualdez and Zaldy Co to file counter-affidavits on flood control corruption charges
Lawyer stated Romualdez is not fleeing the Philippines and faces Ombudsman preliminary investigation for alleged multibillion-peso flood control corruption
Urged alleged 'maleta boys' to 'tell the truth, name names' in the Zaldy Co corruption case
Posted ₱720,000 bail (₱72,000 per person, four counts each) for ten alleged 'maleta boys' on perjury charges
Dismissed recantations in the Co plunder case as irrelevant to proceedings
Identified 32 'grossly anomalous' flood mitigation projects that failed to mitigate floods
Denied Ombudsman Remulla's statement that his camp may be behind the recantation of testimonies by alleged 'maleta boys,' calling Remulla 'extremely prejudiced'

key_actors.name: Martin Romualdez
key_actors.role: Former House Speaker, subject of Ombudsman preliminary investigation
key_actors.stated_position: Not fleeing Philippines; denies involvement in witness recantations; claims Ombudsman is 'extremely prejudiced' against him

key_actors.name: Zaldy Co
key_actors.role: Co-respondent in flood control corruption charges
key_actors.stated_position: No direct statement recorded in source material

key_actors.name: Ombudsman Boying Remulla
key_actors.stated_position: Recantations in Co plunder case are irrelevant; suggested Romualdez camp may be behind witness recantations

key_actors.name: Attorney Levi Baligod
key_actors.role: Lawyer who posted bail for alleged 'maleta boys'
key_actors.stated_position: Questioned source of ₱1 million bail money for detained individuals

key_actors.name: Rep. Abante
key_actors.stated_position: Urged alleged bagmen to voluntarily confess and name names, framing whistleblowing as moral duty

key_actors.name: Sen. Lacson
key_actors.stated_position: Identified 32 flood mitigation projects as 'grossly anomalous' for failing their stated purpose

factual_claims.claim: Ombudsman ordered Romualdez and Zaldy Co to file counter-affidavits on flood control corruption charges on 2026-07-28
Martin Romualdez faces preliminary investigation for alleged multibillion-peso flood control corruption
Ten alleged 'maleta boys' were released on ₱720,000 bail posted by their lawyer (₱72,000 per person, four counts each)
Sen. Lacson counted 32 'grossly anomalous' flood mitigation infrastructure projects that failed to mitigate floods
Former bodyguards were offered ₱20-25 million to recant affidavits implicating President Marcos Jr. and others
Attorney Baligod questioned where detained individuals obtained approximately ₱1 million in bail money

verified_facts.claim: Attorney Baligod questioned where detained individuals obtained approximately ₱1 million in bail money
verified_facts.finding: The claim is contradicted by the provided search results. Attorney Levito Baligod did not question where the detained individuals got the money; rather, he personally shouldered the over ₱1 million required for their bail.

disputed_claims.claim: Romualdez camp is behind the recantation of testimonies by alleged 'maleta boys'
disputed_claims.competing_accounts: Ombudsman Remulla suggested Romualdez camp may be responsible; Romualdez denies this and calls Remulla 'extremely prejudiced against me'

disputed_claims.claim: Recantations in the Co plunder case are legally relevant
disputed_claims.competing_accounts: Ombudsman Remulla dismisses recantations as irrelevant to proceedings; witnesses allegedly recanted under pressure, suggesting intimidation tactics

disputed_claims.claim: Source of bail money for alleged 'maleta boys'
disputed_claims.competing_accounts: Attorney Baligod questioned how detained individuals produced ₱1 million; no official explanation provided in source material

competing_frames.summary: Legal processes are functioning as designed—counter-affidavits ordered, preliminary investigations proceeding, bail posted per legal requirements—demonstrating rule of law

competing_frames.proponents: Journal author/observer, implied critics of enforcement gaps
competing_frames.summary: Procedures create appearance of accountability while actual enforcement remains discretionary, delayed, or absent; recantations and mysterious bail money suggest witness intimidation without consequence
Ombudsman is 'extremely prejudiced' against Romualdez; allegations and investigation driven by political motives rather than evidence
Flood control projects serve as extraction mechanisms rather than functional infrastructure; 32 'grossly anomalous' projects failed their stated purpose, revealing corruption at scale
